rules.binpack: most allocated in place of least allocated, every other plugin as shipped (deploy/kind/binpack-scheduler.yaml)
rules.default: default scoring: least allocated (1), topology spread (2), taint toleration (3); ties at random (Kubernetes 1.35)
rules.kai: bin-packing on the processor, a plain Job's pods one by one, its default queue (schedulingshard_types.go, v0.18.6)
rules.koordinator: the batch pods best effort on batch resources (60% of the machine less the service's use), held to 65% less the service's use, at the least processor weight; load-aware filter at 65% busy (1.8.0)
rules.kueue: one ClusterQueue, quota the workers' processor at install, BestEffortFIFO, a job admitted whole and its quota given back as pods finish, the service's pods admitted one by one; placed by the default scheduler (v0.20.2)
rules.volcano: enqueue gate at 1.2 times the room, jobs in DRF order, PodGroups of one; leastrequested and binpack cancel, the best machines tie, one taken at random (installer/volcano-development.yaml, v1.16.0)
